title: Gatherers everywhere, lenses and languages
done: ocoeco gather (activity, releases, CI) and its reusable workflow, running in all eleven marked repositories; shared tables read through GitHub's API; the lens kind and lens.toml in the harvest; the specification grown to lenses (8) and languages (9), with the rule that a project translates its own data.
considered: Retrying the raw file server; translated columns inside source tables.
rejected: The raw file server (stale for minutes, 501 to empty files); API headers sent to raw files; anyone translating another project's data.

title: ocoeco founded: the principle, the specification, the core
done: The repository and its principle (data made by work, never by hand); SPEC.md version 1 (the tad format at both levels, the mark, the standard tables, propagation, chaining, gatherers); the mark, discovery and the harvest moved in as the ocoeco crate and command, which the observatory now gathers with.
considered: Keeping the machinery in the observatory's engine; renaming tad-engine to ocoeco in place.
rejected: Both: the machinery belongs to the ecosystem, apart from the face; tad-engine keeps its history and stays frozen, tad lives on as the format's name.
